text: In the FLRW metric ds² = −c²dt² + a(t)²[dr²/(1−kr²) + r²dΩ²], the value k = +1 corresponds to:
choices: the curvature of spacetime produced by the matter content
explanation: k labels the constant curvature of the spatial sections: k = +1 is a closed 3-sphere S³, k = 0 is flat R³, and k = −1 is hyperbolic H³. It is a property of space at fixed t, not of the full spacetime — the spacetime is dynamically curved by matter even when k = 0. Do not conflate the spatial curvature sign k with the spacetime curvature sourced by the energy content.
